children: UK meat and prepared foods supplier's H1 revenue up 15.3% yr/yr on higher raw material prices
Adjusted PBT for H1 down 5.2% yr/yr, reflecting seafood segment challenges
Company raised full-year adjusted PBT guidance due to Dalco sale and favourable FX
Hilton Food Group now sees 2026 adj PBT at £66m-£71m, up from £60m-£65m
Company expects positive impact from Seachill improvement plans in H2 2026
Capital expenditure for 2026 expected to be around £100m
CORE MEAT & PREPARED FOOD GROWTH - Co said good performance in core meat and fresh prepared food businesses helped drive volumes and profit in H1
SEAFOOD WEAKNESS - Co said margin pressures and regulatory restrictions at Foppen weighed on profit, with seafood moving to an operating loss
HIGHER RAW MATERIAL PRICES - Co said revenue growth reflected higher average raw material prices across all markets
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food processing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Hilton Food Group PLC is GBp720.00, about 14.1% above its September 2 closing price of GBp631.00
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
